description_en: Queries one or more data sources bound to a policy, or queries one or more policies bound to a data source

kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-policy-bindings --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a --max-results 10 --policy-id po-000000000000000hky --data-source-ids i-uf600000000000068n --source-type UDM_ECS --filters '[{"Operator":"IN","Values":["UDM_ECS"],"Key":"DataSourceType"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePolicyBindings

parameters.help_en: The token required to obtain the next page of policy-data source associations
parameters.help_zh: 获取下一页策略与数据源关联所需的Token
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The list of data source IDs
parameters.name: data_source_ids

parameters.help_en:
The data source type. Valid values:
UDM_ECS: ECS instance backup.
OSS: OSS backup.
NAS: Alibaba Cloud NAS backup.
COMMON_NAS: On-premises NAS backup.
ECS_FILE: ECS File Backup Essential Edition.
File: On-premises file backup.
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM: CPFS backup.
OTS: Tablestore backup
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：
UDM_ECS：表示ECS整机备份。
OSS：表示OSS备份。
NAS：表示阿里云NAS备份。
COMMON_NAS：表示本地NAS备份。
ECS_FILE：表示ECS文件备份标准版。
File：表示本地文件备份。
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM：表示CPFS备份。
OTS: 表示Tablestore备份
parameters.name: source_type

element_fields.help_en:
The key in the query filter. Valid values:

PolicyId: backup policy ID
DataSourceId: ECS instance ID
DataSourceType: data source type
element_fields.help_zh:
查询过滤器中的键值。取值包括：

PolicyId：备份策略ID
DataSourceId：ECS实例ID
DataSourceType：数据源类型
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The matching method. Default value: IN. The matching operation (Operator) supported by the Key and Value in the filter. Valid values:

EQUAL: equal to
NOT_EQUAL: not equal to
GREATER_THAN: greater than
GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL: greater than or equal to
LESS_THAN: less than
LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL: less than or equal to
BETWEEN: range. The value is a JSON array `[lower bound, upper bound]`.
IN: in a set. The value is an array
element_fields.help_zh:
匹配方式。默认为IN。即过滤器中Key和Value支持的匹配操作（Operator）方式，取值包括：

EQUAL：等于
NOT_EQUAL：不等于
GREATER_THAN：大于
GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL：大于等于
LESS_THAN：小于
LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL：小于等于
BETWEEN：区间，value为JSON数组`[下届,上届]`。
IN：在集合中，value为数组
element_fields.name: operator

element_fields.help_en: The values to match in the query filter
element_fields.help_zh: 查询过滤器中的待匹配的值
element_fields.name: values
